set -euo pipefail; echo 'English-only execution evidence.'; EXPECTED=198c93d24f4ec43ed76559b4ba84e8285619c36c; ACTUAL=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo "branch=$(git branch --show-current)"; echo "head=$ACTUAL"; test "$ACTUAL" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then PY=.venv/bin/python; else PY=python3; fi; "$PY" - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json
from tools.ml.simulator import ControlAction, SequentialEnvironmentSimulator, default_scenario_v2
path='schemas/environment-controller.json'
raw=open(path,'rb').read()
data=json.loads(raw)
canonical=json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode()
model=data['model']
outputs=model.get('outputs', data.get('outputs', []))
print('schema_version=', data.get('schema_version'))
print('schema_sha256_canonical=', hashlib.sha256(canonical).hexdigest())
print('schema_blob_sha256=', hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
print('feature_count=', len(model.get('features', [])))
print('output_count_model=', len(outputs))
print('output_scope_count=', data.get('output_scope', {}).get('ml_output_count'))
print('output_names=', [item.get('name') if isinstance(item, dict) else item for item in outputs])
scenario=default_scenario_v2(scenario_id='stage0-baseline', seed=12345)
sim=SequentialEnvironmentSimulator(scenario, seed=12345)
actions=[ControlAction(), ControlAction(heater=0.7), ControlAction(heater=0.7), ControlAction(fan=0.5), ControlAction(humidifier=0.6), ControlAction()]
trace=[]
for cycle in range(6):
    action=actions[cycle]
    for _ in range(5):
        state=sim.step(action, timestep_s=10.0, add_sensor_noise=False)
    trace.append({
        't_s': sim.elapsed_s,
        'temperature_c': round(state.air_temperature_c, 9),
        'humidity_pct': round(state.air_humidity_pct, 9),
        'co2_ppm': round(state.co2_ppm, 9),
        'soil1_pct': round(state.pots[0].soil_moisture_pct, 9),
    })
trace_json=json.dumps(trace, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'))
print('baseline_trace=', trace_json)
print('baseline_trace_sha256=', hashlib.sha256(trace_json.encode()).hexdigest())
PY
